layout_note: FSE 2025 PDCAT artifact (https://github.com/zhumxxx/PDCAT-master). Bundles cBench + PolyBench sources, all five compared auto-tuning techniques, and author result tables.
copy_note: The shared package is read-only. Copy benchmark sources or tuning scripts into project/ before modifying. Write build artifacts and logs under project/ or results/.

instance_counts.note: Single git clone; benchmarks are source trees (not prebuilt binaries). Full auto-tuning runs dominate wall time, not disk.

python_environment.note: Prepared automatically at container startup. System gcc/g++/make/time also on PATH.

not_provided.gcc_13_1_0_exact: Container installs build-essential and prefers gcc-12 when available; exact GCC 13.1.0 is not prebuilt. Pass --gcc_path=gcc to author scripts.
not_provided.full_paper_compute: Full 58×4×3×5 tuning grid may take many days; follow the paper protocol and document blockers if compute is insufficient.
